property_summary: For any admissible call (exactly 10 ether at a strictly increasing timestamp) at block number b, C transfers its entire balance out if and only if b % 15 == 0; the mutant (modulo 7) pays out at blocks like 7 or 14, breaking the iff at blocks divisible by 7 but not 15.
change_summary: Change the modulo constant from 15 to 7 so the payout triggers on a different set of block numbers.
